description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” spans a linear scale from 0 to 10 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” ranges from 30 to 90, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines at 30, 50, 70, and 90. The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers) begins at a reliability score of approximately 85 at cost 0 and declines gradually to about 75 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers) starts slightly higher at approximately 88 reliability and decreases more steeply, ending at roughly 72 at cost 10. GPT-4 (yellow line with circular markers) begins at 90 reliability but exhibits the steepest decline, dropping to approximately 65 at cost 5 and further to about 42 at cost 10. The yellow line intersects the red and blue lines between cost 2 and 4, after which it falls below both ensemble models for all higher cost values. The red line remains above the blue line across the entire cost range, indicating consistently higher reliability for the 2-Model Ensemble compared to the 3-Model Ensemble.

The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line) begins at approximately 85 reliability at a cost of 0 and decreases steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line) starts at roughly 88 reliability and exhibits a sharper decline, reaching approximately 70 at a cost of 10. Notably, the 2-Model Ensemble consistently outperforms the 3-Model Ensemble across all cost levels, while GPT-4 demonstrates a rapid decline in reliability after a cost of 2, intersecting the ensemble models at higher costs.
